core_obligations: Record the implications that follow from stability of formal etaleness under open immersions, including the immediate one.
Assemble formal etaleness of the morphism from the ring-map condition on one affine cover.

proof_roadmap.step: Discharge the implications from open-immersion stability.
Pass from the affine cover condition to the morphism condition.

difficulty_reason: The lemma gives four equivalent formulations of formal etaleness for a morphism of schemes: the morphism itself, its restriction to compatible open subschemes, the ring-map condition on every pair of compatible affine opens, and the same condition on one chosen affine cover. The implications need the compatibility of formal etaleness with open immersions and the passage from affine-local ring maps back to the morphism, so the local-to-global direction is where the work is. Retained author proof at lines 1672-1688 statement, proof 1690-1705.

Conclusion difference: the list of equivalent conditions is entirely different (affine-local formulations here versus chart formulations there), so the propositions differ and both count.
